notes:
Method: every figure was read from the corporation's own page or PDF fetched 2026-10-10 (RTDC HotelDetails pages by plain GET; GTDC tariff-card PDFs, the 2026 one is a scanned image read visually; ANIIDCO resort pages; ATDC lodges page; HRH hotel PDFs, text-extracted; private hotel tariff pages). Two private rows (Girivihar, Lake Pichola) come from search-result snippets because the live page would not load (certificate / mod_security block, not bypassed) and are marked.
Key findings: (1) Only ANIIDCO labels the words Season/Off Season (Andaman: Oct-Apr season, May-Sep off season, 15 Dec-15 Jan peak; off/season 0.60-0.80). (2) RTDC prints dated periods, not labels: Apr-Sep rate is 0.67-0.87 of the Oct-Mar rate for 11 hotels (Moomal Jaisalmer 0.67, Jhoomar Baori 0.74, Kajri Udaipur 0.87), but Mount Abu, Pushkar, Jodhpur, Sariska and Siliserh are flat all year with only Diwali/Christmas/fair windows higher; those windows are mostly MAP vs CP so not like-for-like. (3) GTDC Goa prints NO off-season discount: monsoon-spanning 16 Jun-22 Dec 2026 card is higher than the Jan-Jun card; peak (23 Dec-1 Jan) premium is only 4-8 percent. (4) HRH palaces: Apr-Sep = 0.64-0.80 of Oct-Mar. (5) Several private hotels (Jaiwana, Lake Pichola, Windamere, Gautam) publish one flat annual card. (6) Against the ledger's low = shoulder x 0.65: 23 like-for-like off/season pairs have median 0.75 (range 0.60-0.87), so 0.65 is at the low end; only Megapode (0.60), Fateh Bagh (0.64), Karni Bhawan (0.65) and Moomal (0.67) sit near it. Peak premiums printed over the season rate are 4-8 percent (GTDC), 0-25 percent (ANIIDCO Dolphin), 0 (Killa Bhawan fort rooms) and up to 53 percent (Over The Hill, Kerala, 20 Dec-15 Jan 'super peak' vs season); RTDC Diwali/Christmas windows are +33-61 percent but also upgrade CP to MAP/AP. A x1.35 peak is not contradicted by Over The Hill but is far above GTDC.
Caveats: RTDC/ATDC/GTDC rates are per night, double occupancy as printed, GST extra unless stated. Ratios compare same room type and same meal plan only. rows with ratio_valid=false (Sam Dhani, Calangute) or stale=true must not be used for ratios.
